description: Builds the conceptual model of an OWL/RDF ontology from its ratified terms and competency questions: glossary, class taxonomy, property designs, and alignment to the upper ontology the scope document names (BFO, another, or none). Detects ontology modeling anti-patterns. Use when designing the structure of an ontology before formalization; not for application data models, database schemas or software design.
